# Security Policy

`elixir-hy` is a static website built with Jekyll and deployed to GitHub Pages. The project does not run an application backend or intentionally collect user data.

Security issues may still affect the project, including:

* vulnerabilities in the build or deployment configuration;
* compromised dependencies or GitHub Actions;
* malicious or compromised links;
* other issues that could make the deployed site unsafe for visitors.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities in public issues.

Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting:

https://github.com/vontanne/elixir-hy/security/advisories/new

Security reports are handled privately through GitHub.

For non-security issues such as typos, inaccurate information, or broken links, please use the regular [issue templates](https://github.com/vontanne/elixir-hy/issues/new/choose).
